definitions.explanation: Food preserved or flavored by exposure to smoke from burning wood or chips. Also refers to the process of smoking food. Common smoked foods include salmon, cheese, ham, and sausage.

examples.japanese: {燻製|くんせい}のチーズが{好|す}きだ。
{自宅|じたく}で{燻製|くんせい}を{作|つく}るのが{趣味|しゅみ}です。
examples.english: My hobby is making smoked foods at home.

examples.japanese: キャンプで{燻製|くんせい}に{挑戦|ちょうせん}したら、{思|おも}った{以上|いじょう}においしくできた。
examples.english: When I tried making smoked food while camping, it turned out tastier than expected.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both for the smoking process and for the resulting smoked product. Home smoking has become a popular hobby in Japan, especially among camping and outdoor enthusiasts. Also written as {薫製|くんせい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {燻製|くんせい}を{作|つく}る: to make smoked food
- {燻製|くんせい}サーモン: smoked salmon
- {燻製|くんせい}チーズ: smoked cheese
- {燻製|くんせい}{器|き}: smoker (device)
- {自家|じか}{製|せい}{燻製|くんせい}: homemade smoked food
